Tyre wear: an invisible contributor to air pollution
News
31 August 2026
PhD student Ether Lenssen investigated the health effects of this and found, in addition to an increase in white blood cells, an elevated risk of premature death.
Can you explain your research in three minutes? Breaking Science is looking for participants
News
5 March 2026
Are you a PhD candidate or postdoctoral researcher who enjoys the challenge of explaining complex research to non-experts, such as friends, family, or a general audience? Apply for Breaking Science before March 20!
‘Veterinary Disciplinary Law Can and Must Be Improved’
News
10 February 2026
Iaira Boissevain will defend her PhD at Utrecht University with a study on veterinary disciplinary law. According to her, the system can be far more effective.
